r1_changes.0012: Emanuele Ghidoli's 'ASoC: soc-core: reset rtd->num_components after allocation' (lore 20261109102536.357134-1-ghidoliemanuele@gmail.com, v1, Reviewed-by Takashi Iwai, not yet merged upstream at r1). v7.4-rc2's 4dd10fbbeb9c made soc_new_pcm_runtime() use devm_kzalloc_flex(), which presets the __counted_by() counter num_components to the slot count when the compiler has __builtin_counted_by_ref() (GCC 16 here); snd_soc_rtd_add_component() then stores past components[] and no component is attached to the card. On neko-yoga7i-258v this oopsed in snd_soc_card_get_kcontrol during CS35L56 probe on every r0 boot. Kees Cook prefers a separate allocation-size counter; replace 0012 with whatever lands upstream.
